scientific_integrity: Uniform proof by explicit dominating neighbor and an exhaustive nine-fold finite certificate; finite implementation is corroborative only. Not independently validated.
scientific_limitations: Strong-collapse classification is for all sizes with at most three parts, together with the single four-part example n=8. No general four-part formula, equivariant classification or persistence claim. Previously known unrestricted full-complex wedge theorem is credited.
title: A sharp strong-collapse boundary in partition-transfer clique complexes
